description: Destinação de resíduos sólidos is a dataset listed in City of Recife open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Empresa de Manutenção e Limpeza Urbana - EMLURB. Apresenta os dados georreferenciados dos pontos de descarte de resíduos, descrevendo os tipos de resíduos que são recebidos em cada uma das ecoestações e econúcleos. Coverage: Recife. The portal files it under the publisher Empresa de Manutenção e Limpeza Urbana - EMLURB. Its tags are coleta, coleta seletiva, descarte, ecoestação, econúcleo. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-03-02 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-recife-portal.
